basic.name: Chain Lightning (Q)
basic.description: Shock an enemy with lightning, dealing 162 damage. The lightning then bounces 3 times to nearby enemies, dealing 81 damage to each enemy hit.

basic.name: Feral Spirit (W)
basic.description: Unleash a Feral Spirit that deals 153 damage to enemies in its path and Roots Heroes hit for 1 second. Each Hero hit increases the distance traveled by 25%.

basic.name: Windfury (E)
basic.description: Increase Thrall's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds. His next 3 Basic Attacks occur 100% faster and generate stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.
passives: {quest}Quest: Basic Attacks against Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active increase Attack Damage by 1{/quest}
basic.developerCommentary: This change itself is pretty basic but it's supposed to hold the funniest Thrall quest baseline and also bring back the original Thrall Far Sight. The vision is intended for late game and that's why a so high threshold
subtexts: Far Sight -> Activate to reveal the targeted area for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds

heroic.name: Sundering (R)
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

heroic.name: Earthquake (R)
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

trait.name: Frostwolf Resilience (T)
trait.description: Dealing damage with Abilities grants 1 stack of Frostwolf Resilience. At 5 stacks, Thrall is instantly healed for 223 Health.

1.name: Echo of the Elements
1.description: {quest}Quest:{/quest} Kill Minions or Heroes within 1.5 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning.{reward}Reward:{/reward} After killing 10 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.{reward}Reward:{/reward} After killing 20 enemies, gain a second charge of Chain Lightning.

1.name: Crash Lightning
1.description: {repeatable_quest}Repeatable Quest:{/repeatable_quest} Hitting at least 2 Heroes with a single use of Chain Lightning increases the damage of its bounces by 12, up to 360.{reward}Reward:{/reward} After hitting multiple Heroes 30 times, Chain Lightning prioritizes bouncing to Heroes.

1.name: Rolling Thunder
1.description: For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.Passive: Increase the number of Chain Lightning bounces by 1.

4.name: Frostwolf's Grace
4.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

4.name: Frostwolf Pack
4.description: {quest}Quest:{/quest} Hit 6 Heroes with Feral Spirit. Progress is lost on death and when Thrall fails to hit a Hero.{reward}Reward:{/reward} Reduce the cooldown and Mana cost of Feral Spirit by 50%.
passives: {highlight}Heroes hit by Feral Spirit grants 3 stacks of Frostwolf Resilience{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: The objective here is to make all talents of level 4 be centered around the passive and Frostwolf Pack is included, a weaker version to use the passive being inconsistent BUT giving another buff in compensation

4.name: Mana Tide
4.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

7.name: Grace of Air
7.description: {highlight}Maelstrom basic attacks will be imbued with air granting twice many stacks of Frostwolf Resilience{/highlight}
7.developerCommentary: Level 7 will now be an extension of the baseline quest to Maelstrom. I made some options for it and this one is supposed to be related for utility to the Character

7.name: Grace of Lava
7.description: {highlight}Maelstrom basic attacks will be imbued with lava dealing 6% maximum health damage over 3 seconds on each attack and Healing Thrall 150% of that damage dealt{/highlight}
7.developerCommentary: This one is reimagining the Frostwolf's Grace but instead of being point and click you need to enter in contact tu use it being a tank burster talent

7.name: Grace of Lightning
7.description: {highlight}Maelstrom basic attacks will now teleport to the target and reduce their armor by 8 on each hit{/highlight}
7.developerCommentary: This is supposed to be an option when trying to handle high mobile and distant targets and remember that all the level 7 talents can be paired with Crash Lightning
subtexts: The teleport range will be 5.0 | Malfurion astral communion is 7
Works the same as the Old Zeratul auto attack teleporting ultimate

10.name: Sundering
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

10.name: Earthquake
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

13.name: Spirit of Lightning
13.description: {highlight}Chain Lightning can now bounce to allied heroes, dealing area damage around them and converting the damage dealt into a shield for the ally.{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: This should bring some scenarios similar to a Cassia using the lighing ball on a 1v1. But besides this just seems like a fun scenario to handle

13.name: Earth Spirit
13.description: {highlight}Frostwolf resilience now grants one stack of block to Thrall and Allied heroes close for 6 seconds reducing the damage of the next basic attack received by 75%. Caps at 3 stacks{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: I enjoy the idea of having physical armor talents and i think that fits on Frostwolf Resilience
subtexts: Radius is 4.4 same as ETC Block Party

13.name: Spirit of Air
13.description: {highlight}Frostwolf Resilience cleanses slows and grants 20 magic resistence for 2 seconds{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: Specific type of cleanses are something that i find cool to see and fitting the fast stacking Frostwolf Resilience has it could be a niche pick against heavy slow comps.

16.name: Tempest Fury
16.description: The final strike of Windfury hits 3 times for 75% normal damage.

16.name: Thunderstorm
16.description: Chain Lightning Slows targets by 8% for 2 seconds.{quest}Quest:{/quest} Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.{reward}Reward:{/reward} While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 25%.Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

16.name: Alpha Wolf
16.description: {highlight}Thrall now mounts an Alpha Wolf, the Alpha Wolf mount can't be dismounted by damage. Casting Spirit Wolf while riding Alpha Wolf empowers it dealing extra 10% maximum health damage to every one hit.{/highlight}
16.developerCommentary: One thing that bothers me is the fact Alpha Wolf doesn't feel like Alpha Wolf

20.name: Shattering Worlds
20.description: {highlight}Sundering now travels the planet until hits the starting point leaving behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement. After 2.5 seconds the rift starts to be destroyed.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: Mixing the old effect with the new one seems the perfect recipe for some crazy plays instead of it simply moving on the map. Even tho it could be argued to be toxic it can also be argued that this gives players Chad feelings. If you want something similar you can check Taliyah League of Legends ultimate https://www.leagueoflegends.com/pt-br/champions/taliyah/
subtexts: It starts to be destroyed from the initial sundering position it will destroy the entire Sundering rift at the same speed Sundering travels
It will work  similarly as the Napalm Strike but will stop at the starting point

20.name: Earthen Shields
20.description: Allies within the Earthquake area gain a Shield equal to 15% of their maximum Health each pulse. This shield lasts 4 seconds.

20.name: ThunderFury
20.description: {highlight}Windfury basic attacks casts a Chain of Lighting at the target.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: Nothing like bouncing that hard earned crash lighintg mission
subtexts: It will work with Rolling Thunder but remember, hitting the same hero target will reset the mission progress

20.name: Feral Violence
20.description: {highlight}Feral Spirit will now travel 25% farther and will continually grow its way to end also increasing root duration up to 1.5 extra seconds{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: Mixing the old effect with the new one seems the perfect recipe for some crazy plays instead of it simply moving on the map. Even tho it could be argued to be toxic it can also be argued that this gives players Chad feelings.
subtexts: getting atleast 60% bigger if it don't hit anyone, i don't know to put that on consistent numbers.
The extra 1.5 duration will cap at the 60% bigger

developerCommentary: Thrall is one of the few characters on Heroes of the Storm that had to be niched in the sense of sharing the same initial concept of other hero, i mean that with Rehgar..Thrall original kit was supposed to be the Rehgar one but instead they split one focusing on enhancement and the other on classic shamanic stuff and i wish to keep that. Right now his kit is solid and functional, the character is not weak but for my changes i wish to bring more power to the character on decision making and remove the generic old talents from his kit.
